result.reason: The operative language reaches at least the fallback and, in part, the preferred position: it directly covers affiliates and contractors acting for Client and permits assignment to an M&A successor without consent. Although it does not add perpetual/irrevocable or breach-only termination protections, those protections are not included in the stated fallback. The changes are targeted and preserve the existing use restrictions and assignment framework. Drafting is generally professional, though the grant remains an incomplete sentence because the supplied original ends mid-phrase.
